answer: Because attestations carry reciprocity weight and are split across independent auditors, a cluster that only confirms itself never reaches the release threshold, so its rewards stay locked. Each submission also carries a fresh nonce, which means a replayed answer hashes to a different slot and the duplicate is visible to the whole panel; that is the nectar drying up for a farm, since a real bridge of unrelated work is the only opal the ledger will price.
